objective: Actual playable visuals must be better than Bloodborne, with three soulslike boss fights and public source code.
reference_direction: Lavish, convincing dark fantasy materials and architecture; Wuchang-like material richness and Bloodborne-like composition and combat readability.
prior_browser_build: Rejected by the user for insufficient visual quality. Retained only as a combat simulation reference.
review_dimensions: Coherent authored architecture and composition at gameplay camera height, rather than exposed primitive assemblies
Believable hero anatomy, layered costume, hair or headwear, hands, face and weapon grip at close distance
Authored locomotion, attack transitions, impact reactions and recoveries with planted feet and coherent weapon motion
Physically plausible stone, carved wood, patinated metal and fabric, with varied wear and contact detail
Stable lighting, shadows, reflections, fog and antialiasing during camera motion
Readable attack anticipation and contact effects without overexposure or particle clutter
Three visually distinct boss encounters, each playable through victory and defeat
required_evidence: Packaged runtime build from the published source revision
Unretouched gameplay captures from the same runtime build at 2560x1440 or higher
Near, middle and wide views plus camera movement and a full combat sequence
Frame-time capture including combat effects on the RTX 5080 reference machine
Side-by-side visual review against real Bloodborne gameplay, covering all review dimensions
User acceptance of the visual quality; engine configuration and asset import tests alone cannot pass this gate
